summary: P1: Futures Strategy Integration (Paper Mode) testing completed. 25/25 pytest tests PASSED. All new endpoints return 200. Frontend renders complete strategy section with all required components.
critical_code_review_comments: Strategy Contract: StrategySignal dataclass with symbol, side, confidence, regime, reason fields implemented correctly
FuturesTrendFollowV1: Generates LONG/SHORT signals when all conditions (regime=TRENDING, trend_strength>threshold, funding_alignment=True) are met
FuturesTrendFollowV1: Returns NONE signal with appropriate reason codes (SPREAD_SHOCK, REGIME_NOT_TRENDING, TREND_STRENGTH_BELOW_THRESHOLD, FUNDING_BIAS_MISALIGNED)
FuturesStrategyEngine: Full chain implemented: strategy_signal -> microstructure_guard -> risk_engine -> liquidation_gate -> adl_gate -> policy_engine -> paper_decision_allow
FuturesPaperExecutor: Creates synthetic lifecycle (paper_position_opened/closed) with paper_pnl calculation without sending real orders

POST /api/admin/futures/strategy/run-paper-cycle: Returns 200 with strategy, generated_at, metrics, signal_feed, decision_trace, paper_trades, paper_pnl_series, reject_reason_breakdown, confidence_distribution
GET /api/admin/futures/strategy/status: Returns cached or fresh strategy status with all required fields
Frontend AdminFuturesRiskMonitorPage: Renders complete strategy section at bottom of page

UI Components verified: Strategy header (Paper Mode), 5 metrics cards (Signal Total, Allowed, Rejected, Avg Confidence, Paper PnL), Signal Feed table, Decision Trace panel, Paper PnL Chart, Reject Reasons panel, Confidence Distribution panel
Regression tests passed: /api/admin/futures/risk/status and /api/admin/futures/liquidation-protection/status still return 200

success_rate.backend: 100% (25/25 pytest tests passed, new endpoints working)

seed_data_creation: None - strategy generates signals from live market data cache (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT)
